edges.reason: Constructor assigns the caller-controlled msg.sender directly to the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner before transferOwnership proceeds.
onlyOwner modifier on pause gates execution on msg.sender equality with owner.
onlyOwner modifier on unpause gates execution on msg.sender equality with owner.
onlyOwner modifier on mint restricts token creation to the owner address.
onlyOwner modifier on finishMinting restricts stopping minting to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier on finalize restricts presale finalization to the owner.
onlyOwner modifier on setContactInformation restricts the setter to the owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-controlled address as token source.
transferFrom reads and writes allowed[_from][msg.sender] using the caller as spender.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as beneficiary to buyTokens and emitted in TokenPurchase.
Payable fallback forwards every plain ether transfer into buyTokens.
buyTokens requires validPurchase() to return true before issuing tokens.
buyTokens increases weiRaised by the local weiAmount derived from msg.value.
buyTokens performs an external mint call on the token contract during the purchase.
buyTokens invokes forwardFunds which performs an external ether transfer after minting.
forwardFunds executes the ether-sending transfer to the wallet address.
Ether forwarded by transfer is received by the wallet state variable address.
Token minting credits balances[_to] inside the token contract.
Token minting increases the tokens totalSupply by the minted amount.
validPurchase reads weiRaised when computing the prospective total contribution.
validPurchase multiplies contribution by rate to evaluate the cap.
validPurchase compares msg.value against minInvestment.
validPurchase compares computed token amount against cap.
hasEnded reads weiRaised to determine whether the cap has been reached.
hasEnded multiplies weiRaised by rate when evaluating the cap.
hasEnded compares the raised value against cap.
finalize requires hasEnded() to be true before proceeding.
isFinalized guards finalize against repeated execution.
finalize sets isFinalized to true at the end of execution.
finalize performs an external finishMinting call on the token contract.
Presale constructor calls createTokenContract to deploy the token.
createTokenContract deploys a new ProofPresaleToken instance.
Deployed token address returned by createTokenContract is stored in token.
Presale constructor assigns the created contract to the token state variable.
Presale constructor hard-codes the fund collection wallet address.
Presale constructor initializes the token per ether rate.
Presale constructor initializes the minimum investment threshold.
Presale constructor initializes the token cap.
whenNotPaused modifier checks the paused flag before buyTokens executes.
canMint modifier checks mintingFinished before minting is allowed.
finishMinting sets mintingFinished to true, permanently blocking mints.
mint increases totalSupply by the minted amount.
mint credits balances[_to] with the minted amount.
transfer debits and credits entries of the balances mapping.
transferFrom credits balances[_to] and debits balances[_from].
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance entry after spending.
approve writes the requested amount into the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable with newOwner.
pause sets the paused flag to true.
unpause sets the paused flag to false.
setContactInformation writes the info string into contactInformation.
newOwner parameter flows into the owner assignment performed by transferOwnership.
_to parameter is the credited destination of the transfer.
_value parameter determines the amount subtracted and added in transfer.
_from parameter identifies the debited account in transferFrom.
_to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
_value parameter sets how much allowance and balance are consumed.
_spender parameter is the allowance key written by approve.
_value parameter is the allowance amount written by approve.
_to parameter is the mint recipient credited by mint.
_amount parameter is added to totalSupply and to the recipient balance.
beneficiary parameter is validated and used inside buyTokens.
beneficiary parameter is forwarded to the external token.mint call.
info parameter is the string stored by setContactInformation.
_allowance local caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] and is decremented in transferFrom.
weiAmount local derived from msg.value is added to weiRaised.
weiAmount local is multiplied by rate to produce the tokens local.
tokens local is the amount passed to the external token.mint call.
weiAmount local in validPurchase feeds the withinCap computation.
weiAmount local is evaluated alongside the minimum amount check.
notSmallAmount local is returned as part of the validPurchase result.
withinCap local is returned as part of the validPurchase result.
capReached local is the boolean returned by hasEnded.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a function parameter whose only role is to be assigned into the owner state variable inside transferOwnership.
_to is a transfer parameter consumed only by the transfer function to credit balances.
_value is a transfer parameter consumed only by the transfer function to size the debit and credit.
_from is a transferFrom parameter used only to locate and debit the source balance.
_to is a transferFrom parameter used only to credit the destination balance.
_value is a transferFrom parameter that sizes the debit, credit and allowance reduction.
_spender is an approve parameter used solely as the allowance mapping key.
_value is an approve parameter used solely as the allowance amount written.
_to is a mint parameter that only receives the newly created balance entry.
_amount is a mint parameter that only sizes the totalSupply and balance increase.
beneficiary is a buyTokens parameter whose validity check and downstream use are local to the purchase flow.
info is a setter parameter whose only effect is writing the contactInformation state variable.
_allowance is a short-lived local caching the caller allowance within transferFrom.
weiAmount is a local snapshot of msg.value used only inside buyTokens accounting.
tokens is a local computed amount whose only consumer is the external token.mint call.
weiAmount is a local intermediate sum used only inside the validPurchase condition.
notSmallAmount is a local boolean sub-result of the validPurchase return expression.
withinCap is a local boolean sub-result of the validPurchase return expression.
capReached is a local boolean that is directly returned by hasEnded.
